scope: Native page/word rounding and wrap, ignored erase errors versus rejected writes, bounded multi-page loops, exact wait/poll/watchdog/delay sequence, mapped forward byte-copy including overlap, event low-byte IDs/results and pending flag, guards/registers
limitations: Nonzero page size and bounded erase iteration counts are covered; C division by zero is not a portable native contract.

SDK busy replies are canonical bool0/1; API callbacks, polling, watchdog and delay results are fixtures. SDK facades execute actual C only in integration mode. Poll-time pending mutation is controlled, not a real SDK interrupt.
Mapped copy ranges are bounded; invalid pointers, real flash persistence, scheduling, original compiler/link identity and full image remain unproven.
